rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a concrete template for organizing and describing a presidentially sponsored White House conference: it specifies meeting dates and an Executive Office Building location, identifies the invited participant group, delegates substantive discussions to executive officials, and states the conference's intended cooperative result. The child adapts that same sequence to the World Refugee Year. C19 is also structurally relevant as a White House conference directive involving governmental leadership and private participation, while C06 supplies refugee-related concepts and some similar humanitarian/free-world phrasing but not the child's meeting machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: sponsor a White House meeting ... I have set May 21 and May 22 for such a meeting, to be held in the Indian Treaty Room of the Executive Office Building
shared_material.parent_excerpt: attend a conference here in the White House on May fourth and fifth ... join with me at ten o'clock on May fourth in Room 474 of the Executive Office Building
shared_material.explanation: Both letters announce a presidential White House conference using the same concrete pattern of dates and an Executive Office Building venue.

shared_material.child_excerpt: under the direction of Deputy Under Secretary of State Loy W. Henderson
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I shall call upon my associates in the Executive Branch to lead subsequent discussions
shared_material.explanation: Both delegate the working sessions to executive-branch officials while retaining presidential sponsorship.

shared_material.child_excerpt: invite to it a representative group of private citizens whose interests and experience should prove of utmost value in considering all aspects of this important matter
shared_material.parent_excerpt: an occasion which offers the prospect of America's leaders, State and national, working side by side ... this conference will produce a better understanding ... for the full cooperation of each of you
shared_material.explanation: Both frame selected attendees as contributing their experience and cooperation toward consideration of a national and international problem.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I will be unable personally to participate in the meeting, but I hope that it will assist in the formulation of specific plans
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I do look forward to greeting you at the opening session ... After luncheon the discussions will resume
shared_material.explanation: The child modifies the parent's presidential-participation paragraph while preserving the distinction between presidential sponsorship and working discussions conducted by others.
